function run<U>(f: (x: number) => Generator<U>) { return [...f(1)]; }
console.log(run(function* (x) { yield x * 2; }));
console.log(run(function* (x) { yield x; }));
const r: string[] = run(function* (x) { yield String(x); });
console.log(r);
const g: () => Generator<string> = function* () {
  yield 1;
};
function* h(): Generator<string> {
  yield 2;
}
console.log(g, h);
